rows.note: Use this for something worth a lot of money, especially an item or possession.

example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 gau6 biu1 hou2 zik6 cin2

rows.note: Use this when something is valuable because it is rare, precious, or greatly treasured.

example.english: This photo is very valuable to me.
example.traditional: 呢張相對我嚟講好珍貴。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 soeng2 deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2 hou2 zan1 gwai3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose rendering for something that has significant value, especially in an abstract or general sense.

example.english: This experience will be valuable to you in the future.
example.traditional: 呢個經驗對你將來好有價值。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ging1 jim6 deoi3 nei5 zoeng1 loi4 hou2 jau5 gaa3 zik6
